characters.continuity: DC Comics Modern Age (1997-98 electric Superman era, Superman vol. 2 #122-#135, Action Comics, Adventures of Superman, Superman: The Man of Steel)
characters.summary: Superman Blue is the electric, energy-based form of Superman who relies on a containment suit to hold his non-corporeal energy together. He projects energy blasts, flies, turns intangible, and controls electromagnetic phenomena.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to containment suit damage or energy-draining fields
Loss of physical mass makes standard Kryptonian brute force less direct
Outside his transformed energy state he has only the durability of a normal human
Energy form disperses without its containment suit

depictions.title: DC Comics Modern Age (1997-98 electric Superman era, Superman vol. 2 #122-#135)

Susceptible to power drain and anti-energy weapons
Electric powers can only be used while transformed
Requires a containment suit to keep his energy from dispersing
Detecting energy works only while transformed
characters.formDifferences: Changes Superman from a physical Kryptonian powered by solar radiation to an unstable being of pure electromagnetic energy requiring a containment suit, swapping physical strength for versatile energy manipulation, intangibility, and electrical projection.

sources.supports: General overview of Superman and the 1997-1998 electric blue status quo.
Details of Superman Blue abilities including energy manipulation and containment suit dependency.

Energy-based abilities requiring a containment suit (Superman vol. 2 #122); human durability while depowered; the split by Cyborg Superman and Toyman (Superman Red/Superman Blue #1); Blue as the more cerebral half; reunion after the Millennium Giants battle (Superman vol. 2 #135).
Electric powers usable only when transformed: intangibility, flight, electrical control, turning into lightning, energy detection; blue-and-white containment suit; Blue as the thoughtful half.

Split into two mostly identical energy Supermen during the Toyman/Cyborg Superman trap; becoming two let him stop both villains; each can turn into a fully vulnerable Clark Kent; Blue colder and more logical.

notableResults.note: Split into Superman Red and Blue to defeat the trap set by Toyman and Cyborg Superman.
Trapped by the pair; the split into Red and Blue let Superman stop both villains at once.
